chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, may Allah be pleased with him, wrote to Abū Muḥammad al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام:
A man bequeathed one-third of his wealth concerning his male and female freed slaves: are the male and the female equal in it, or...
"For the male is the like of the share of two females."
So he عليه السلام wrote in reply: "It is valid for the deceased whatever he bequeathed, according to what he bequeathed, if Allah, the Exalted, wills."

key_terms.بِثُلُثِ: one-third, the portion of the estate designated in the will
key_terms.لِلْمَيِّتِ: for the deceased, i.e., as pertaining to his bequest
key_terms.مَوَالِيهِ: his male freed slaves or clients
key_terms.مَوْلَيَاتِهِ: his female freed slaves or clients

ai.seo_question: Is a bequest from one-third of an estate distributed exactly according to the deceased's stated terms?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of a bequest made from one-third of a person's estate for his male and female dependents or freed slaves. Imam al-Hasan ibn ʿAli al-ʿAskari عليه السلام states that the bequest is to be carried out according to the exact manner specified by the deceased.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5485 - Muhammad bin Al-Hasan Al-Saffar, may Allah (swt) be pleased with him, wrote to Abu Muhammad Imam Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari (as)
regarding a man who bequeathed one-third of his wealth to his male and female servants, either equally
or with the instruction that "the male should receive the share of two females"
Abu Muhammad (as) replied: "It is permissible for the deceased to bequeath according to what he specified, if Allah (swt) the Exalted wills."
